The LCS-EN indicator measures how households cope with challenges in meeting essential needs, encompassing not only food but also shelter, health, education, and other basic services. It captures medium- and long-term coping behaviours that reflect a household’s ability to manage and recover from shocks such as conflict, climate events, or economic crises.

Households are asked whether they engaged in specific strategies in the past 30 days or exhausted them in the past 12 months due to a lack of resources to meet essential needs. These strategies are categorized by severity - stress, crisis, and emergency - based on their long-term impact on household well-being and productivity.

More details on the indicator can be found here: https://vamresources.manuals.wfp.org/docs/livelihood-coping-strategies-essential-needs


Please note that in FDS, we do have "Essential Needs" component of LCSI. 
 
# Indicator Calculation 


## LCSI - EN

```{r}
#LcsEN_stress_DomAsset - Food10p
#LcsEN_stress_Saving - Food10h
#LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood- Food10k
#LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash - Food10e
#LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets - Food10g 
#LcsEN_crisis_Health - Food10j
#LcsEN_crisis_OutSchool - Food10l  and Food10m
#LcsEN_em_ResAsse - Food10q 
#LcsEN_em_Begged- Food10bb
#LcsEN_em_IllegalAct - Food10f 


main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    # Stress strategies
    LcsEN_stress_DomAsset = Food10p,
    LcsEN_stress_Saving = Food10h,
    LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood = Food10k,
    LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash = Food10e,

    # Crisis strategies
    LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets = Food10g,
    LcsEN_crisis_Health = Food10j,
    LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolf = Food10l, #girl
    LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolm = Food10m, #boy

    # Emergency strategies
    LcsEN_em_ResAsset = Food10q,
    LcsEN_em_Begged = Food10bb,
    LcsEN_em_IllegalAct = Food10f
  )
```

```{r}
#assign variable and value labels
#variable labels

var_label(main$LcsEN_stress_DomAsset) <- "Sold household assets/goods (radio, furniture, television, jewellery etc.) to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_stress_Saving) <- "Spent savings to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood) <- "Purchased food or other essential items on credit"
var_label(main$LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash) <- "Borrowed money to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets) <- "Sold productive assets or means of transport (sewing machine, wheelbarrow, bicycle, car, etc.) to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_crisis_Health) <- "Reduced expenses on health (including drugs) to meet other essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolm) <- "Withdrew children (boy) from school to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolf) <- "Withdrew children (girl) from school to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_em_ResAsset) <- "Mortgaged/Sold house that the household was permanently living in or sold land to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_em_Begged) <- "Begged and/or scavenged (asked strangers for money/food) to meet essential needs"
var_label(main$LcsEN_em_IllegalAct) <- "Engaged in socially degrading, high risk, or exploitive jobs, or life-threatening income activities (e.g., smuggling, theft, join armed groups, prostitution) to meet essential needs"
```

```{r}
#value labels


main <- main %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(
      LcsEN_stress_DomAsset,
      LcsEN_stress_Saving,
      LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood,
      LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash,
      LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets,
      LcsEN_crisis_Health,
      LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolm,
      LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolf,
      LcsEN_em_ResAsset,
      LcsEN_em_Begged,
      LcsEN_em_IllegalAct
    ),
    ~ case_when(
      . == 1 ~ 30,
      . == 2 ~ 10,
      . == 3 ~ 20,
      . == 4 ~ 9999,
      . == 98 ~ 9999,
      . == 99 ~ 9999,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # handles any other unexpected values
    )
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(
      LcsEN_stress_DomAsset,
      LcsEN_stress_Saving,
      LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood,
      LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash,
      LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets,
      LcsEN_crisis_Health,
      LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolm,
      LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolf,
      LcsEN_em_ResAsset,
      LcsEN_em_Begged,
      LcsEN_em_IllegalAct
    ),
    ~ labelled(., labels = c(
      "No, because I did not need to" = 10,
      "No, because I already sold those assets or have engaged in this activity within the last 12 months and cannot continue to do it" = 20,
      "Yes" = 30,
      "Not applicable (don’t have access to this strategy)" = 9999
    ))
  ))

```

```{r}
#create a variable to specify if the household used any of the strategies by severity
#stress
main <- main %>% mutate(stress_coping_EN = case_when(
  LcsEN_stress_DomAsset == 20 |  LcsEN_stress_DomAsset == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_stress_Saving == 20 | LcsEN_stress_Saving == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood == 20 | LcsEN_stress_CrdtFood == 30 ~1,
  LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash == 20 | LcsEN_stress_BorrowCash == 30 ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ 0))
var_label(main$stress_coping_EN) <- "Did the HH engage in stress coping strategies"
#Crisis
main <- main %>% mutate(crisis_coping_EN = case_when(
  LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets == 20 |  LcsEN_crisis_ProdAssets == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_crisis_Health == 20 | LcsEN_crisis_Health == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolm == 20 | LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolm == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolf == 20 | LcsEN_crisis_OutSchoolf == 30 ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ 0))
var_label(main$crisis_coping_EN) <- "Did the HH engage in crisis coping strategies"
#Emergency
main <- main %>% mutate(emergency_coping_EN = case_when(
  LcsEN_em_ResAsset == 20 |  LcsEN_em_ResAsset == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_em_Begged == 20 | LcsEN_em_Begged == 30 ~ 1,
  LcsEN_em_IllegalAct == 20 | LcsEN_em_IllegalAct == 30 ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ 0))
var_label(main$emergency_coping_EN) <- "Did the HH engage in emergency coping strategies"

#calculate Max_coping_behaviour
main <- main %>% mutate(
  Max_coping_behaviourEN = case_when(
    emergency_coping_EN == 1 ~ 4,
    crisis_coping_EN == 1 ~ 3,
    stress_coping_EN == 1 ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
) |>
  mutate(Max_coping_behaviourEN = labelled(
    Max_coping_behaviourEN,
    labels = c(
      "HH not adopting coping strategies" = 1,
      "Stress coping strategies" = 2,
      "Crisis coping strategies" = 3,
      "Emergencies coping strategies" = 4
    )))
```

FDS_XXX_202X_main <- main %>%
  filter(!is.na(wgh_samp_pop_restr)) %>%
  as_survey_design(

lcsi <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  group_by(Intro_07, Max_coping_behaviourEN) %>%
  summarize(percentage = 100*survey_prop()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Max_coping_behaviourEN = labelled::to_factor(Max_coping_behaviourEN))
